text:
Luca (People Ops): María noticed her April paystub shows Spanish Seguridad Social and US FICA both withheld for the same pay period. Can payroll + mobility take a look? Pay period 2025-04-01 to 2025-04-30.

Paystub excerpt:
```text
Gross: EUR 5,400
Seguridad Social (ESP): EUR 860
US FICA: USD 190
401(k) pre-tax: USD 120
Net: EUR 3,950 (converted)
```
Link: <https://payroll.redwood/secure/stubs/MariaG/2025-04>

María G.: I landed in Madrid 2025-03-28 on a local contract (start 04/01). I uploaded NIE and social registration on 03/30. I shouldn't be paying FICA for April.

Jin (Payroll): Can I get Payrun ID + GID? Also check whether country switch applied before file export cutoff.

Sofia (Payroll Ops): Payrun PR-20250430-66, GID RWF-5784. System record country_code=ES as of 2025-03-31, but export included `FICA_US` and `401K_US_PRE` elements due to legacy benefits flag `retain_us_election=true` on the profile. Looks like benefits vendor mapping didn't flip on country change.

payroll-bot: Ticket #PAY-10820 created: "María G - Spain social + FICA double withholding". Assigned: Sofia. <https://payroll.redwood/tickets/PAY-10820>

Camila (Global Mobility): Mobility confirms local hire effective 2025-04-01; NIE and afiliacin a la Seguridad Social uploaded 2025-03-30. I'll attach docs to PAY-10820.

Tom (Tax): Two points: 1) Spain-United States don't have a social security totalization exception that would require dual coverage if an employee is on the Spanish system; the Seguridad Social should supersede FICA for a local hire. 2) Payroll should reverse FICA and unwind 401(k) deferral; if reversal posts after US year-end, a W-2c may be required. We'll prepare tax notes for the reclaim.

María G.: Will I need to claim anything personally? Im worried about timing and being out-of-pocket for the Seguridad Social refund if process takes time.

Sofia (Payroll Ops): Plan: 1) Reverse `FICA_US` and `401K_US_PRE` from PR-20250430-66 and post a net correction for April to restore María's net. 2) Contact 401(k) vendor to refund any erroneous deferral. 3) Prepare employer reclaim documentation for Seguridad Social if Spanish authority requires employer-side proof. ETA: reversals and net fix targeted by next payroll (05/15); vendor contact today.

Jin (Payroll): Once reversals are posted I'll send the journal entries to payroll-recon and mark month close adjusted. Also flag benefits platform to flip country mapping to ES for this employee to prevent recurrence.

Camila (Global Mobility): I'll send NIE + afiliacin confirmation into PAY-10820 and reach out to our Madrid ER rep for local reclaim steps and expected timelines.

payroll-bot: PAY-10820 status updated -> "in progress" (assignee: Sofia).

Tom (Tax): We'll monitor whether reversal occurs before W-2 generation. If not, we will plan for a W-2c and coordinate messaging. Also check whether Spanish employer/social contributions were withheld by the employer and if any employer-side refunds are needed.

Sofia (Payroll Ops): Quick note: benefits platform still had `country=US` flagged at export time; I'll open a vendor ticket to patch the country sync mapping rules.

Luca (People Ops): Summary/actions: Sofia  reverse FICA + 401k + net correction + vendor contact; Camila  upload docs + ER contact; Jin  reconcile journals; Tom  monitor W-2/tax impact. María, we'll DM timeline for your net correction. Thanks everyone.
